scope: Touch modal, full-bag and recovery fixtures. Draft/victory phases and loot are arranged; extraction and all UI transactions are real. Not a defense or balance proof.

checks.name: Checkpoint recovery is reachable before starting a campaign
Draft takes input away from touch combat
Scrolled reward commits once and restores control
Orientation change clears held movement and attack
Blur has no remaining touch pointer owners
Full bag leaves the nearby drop on the ground
Touch can replace a full-bag item without auto-equipping
Results expose weapon review and checkpoint actions
Weapon review returns to a suspended victory receipt
Results save menu exposes only recovery actions
Touch export downloads the actual checkpoint
Invalid import preserves the checkpoint
Closing save recovery keeps the receipt and input suspension
Collection phase exposes a route back to extraction
Touch reopens the actual planet receipt
Touch starts Endless after a cleared planet
Touch ends Endless at the heart and restores extraction
Touch extraction reloads the next planet with banked weapons
Defeat hides unavailable weapon review but retains saves
No runtime errors
